A mainstay in any fisherman's home, the crisp crust pairs well with the fishy flavor.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Fish Pies are made in a [[Cooking Pot]] by combining [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Goat Butter]], [[Rock Salt]], and any type of Seafood. This includes [[Fish]], [[Crab]]s, [[Sneaky River Snail]]s, and [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]]s. Either [[Hyrule Bass]]es or [[Sanke Carp]]s must be used to make regular Fish Pies. They can be eaten to restore four [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]], but they can also be sold for 40 [[Rupee]]s. They are considered a mainstay in the homes of fishermen, and their crisp crust is known to pair well with their fishy flavor. Depending on what ingredients are used and whether additional ingredients are added, Fish Pies can be of the following variations: * '''Hearty Fish Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Fish Pie}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A mainstay in any fisherman's home, the crisp crust pairs well with the fishy flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} They can be made by using a [[Hearty Bass]], [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]], [[Hearty Salmon]], or other hearty ingredient. Eating one restores all of Link's Hearts and grants him temporary additional Hearts as well. They also sell for 70 Rupees. * '''Energizing Fish Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Fish Pie}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A mainstay in any fisherman's home, the crisp crust pairs well with the fishy flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Staminoka Bass]]es, [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s, or other energizing ingredients. When eaten, they will replenish some of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. They heal Link for four Hearts, and they sell for 50 or 70 Rupees, depending on the ingredient used. * '''Enduring Fish Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Fish Pie}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
A mainstay in any fisherman's home, the crisp crust pairs well with the fishy flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring-type ingredients to the recipe, such as [[Endura Shroom]]s or [[Endura Carrot]]s. They restore and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel when eaten. They restore six Hearts to Link's Life Gauge and sell for 60 Rupees. * '''Hasty Fish Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Fish Pie}}
Grants a mid-level movement-speed boost.
A mainstay in any fisherman's home, the crisp crust pairs well with the fishy flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding speed-type ingredients, such as [[Swift Violet]]s. If they are eaten, they will temporarily increase Link's movement speed. They also restore two Hearts to his Life Gauge, but they can also be sold for 70 Rupees. * '''Spicy Fish Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Fish Pie}}
Grants a low-level cold resistance.
A mainstay in any fisherman's home, the crisp crust pairs well with the fishy flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s or [[Spicy Pepper]]s. Eating one grants Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] for a short period of time. They will heal four of Link's Hearts, and sell for 40 to 50 Rupees. * '''Electro Fish Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Fish Pie}}
Grants mid-level electricity resistance.
A mainstay in any fisherman's home, the crisp crust pairs well with the fishy flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Voltfin Trout]] or other electricity-related ingredients. When consumed, these pies will grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. They heal four Hearts in Link's Life Gauge and sell for 40 Rupees. * '''Mighty Fish Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Fish Pie}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
A mainstay in any fisherman's home, the crisp crust pairs well with the fishy flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Mighty Carp]]s, [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]], [[Razorclaw Crab]]s, or other attack boosting ingredients. Eating one will temporarily increase Link's attack power. They heal four Hearts, but they sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Tough Fish Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Fish Pie}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
A mainstay in any fisherman's home, the crisp crust pairs well with the fishy flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Armored Carp]]s, [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]], [[Ironshell Crab]]s, or other defensive ingredients. Eating them temporarily increases Link's defensive abilities. They also heal Link for four Hearts and sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Sneaky Fish Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Fish Pie}}
Grants a mid-level stealth boost.
A mainstay in any fisherman's home, the crisp crust pairs well with the fishy flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Stealthfin Trout]]s, [[Sneaky River Snail]]s, or other stealth ingredients. When eaten, Link's [[Stealth]] abilities will be temporarily boosted. They heal four Hearts in his Life Gauge, but they sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Chilly Fish Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Fish Pie}}
Grants a low-level heat resistance.
A mainstay in any fisherman's home, the crisp crust pairs well with the fishy flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Chillfin Trout]]s or other icy ingredients. Eating one temporarily increases Link's [[Heat Resistance]] by one level. They restore four of Link's Hearts, and they can be sold for 50 Rupees. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for Fish Pie is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[Just like Mama Made]]". It is made using one [[Tabantha Wheat]], one [[Goat Butter]], one [[Rock Salt]], and one [[Armored Carp]]. When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Warrior]]s will take 5% less damage. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Fish Pie Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Fish Pie icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Pies, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
